_readme: Image manifest for the microscope focus game. umPerPx is null until calibrated: measure the width of 10-20 cells in pixels (or the scale bar, where present) and divide by calibrationRef.um. All images below are ~1000x oil-immersion micrographs, so they serve the 100x stage only.

images.author: Y tambe
images.creditLine: Staphylococcus aureus, Gram stain. Y tambe, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0. Cropped and blurred.
images.notes: Low resolution. Candidate upgrade: File:Staphylococcus_aureus_Gram_stain.jpg (6000x4000) - license not yet verified.

images.notes: High resolution - can supply several different crops.
